data.name: Wyndham
data.gender_notes: Wyndham is used as a male name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: From the Old English 'wynn' meaning friend and 'dūn' meaning hill or homestead. This name was given to someone who lived in a windy location. The name Wyndham carries the meaning “Friend of the wind” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Wyndham usually hope their child will grow to embody friend of the wind and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Invocation of the wind as a symbol of change and transition.
data.etymology: Wyndham belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “Friend of the wind.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Wyndham total 7, giving a life-path number of 7. Number 7 is linked with Ketu and with the qualities of reflection, wisdom and inner depth.
